_comment: Template for ReYOLOv8 + radar fusion + distance estimation

_key_flags.use_raw_events: true - Store raw events for representation at training time
_key_flags.clip_mode: sequence - Store entire session as one sequence
_key_flags.event_representation: vtei - creates 10 channels, +1 for radar = 11 total
_key_flags.filter_classes: List of class names to filter (e.g. ['person']). IDs Original COCO IDs preserved.
_key_flags.pad_size: [width_pad, height_pad] - Padding to add after pooling

_comment: Radar source for fusion and distance extraction
